payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the types of pretrained word embeddings used in the system, including emoji embeddings and word vectors created from a Twitter dataset.

claims.text: The system used emoji embeddings learned from emoji descriptions.
Word vectors were created specifically using the Twitter dataset.
Emoji embeddings provided better results than plain GloVe and Edinburgh embeddings.
Embeddings for each tweet were obtained by summing individual word vectors.
